This 3-Day Online program can stop your overthinking and teach you to Master your Mind:
Experience the timeless meditation practice that Lord Buddha himself practiced and shared - Anapanasati, the art of mindful breathing.
In this 20-minute guided session, you’ll journey through three levels of awareness:
Level 1 (5 min): Gentle observation of the breath
Level 2 (10 min): Deepening awareness and focus
Level 3 (20 min): Complete stillness and inner silence
This simple yet powerful practice helps you:
Calm your restless mind
